sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt: The chart below shows the GDP growth per year for three countries between 2007 and 2010. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

Some people think that activities done in a person's free time should be planned, while others disagree. Discuss both sides and give your opinion. Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
